verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only vaguely references 'custom channels for full customization' via developer tools, with no explicit mention of native SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat channel support inside the same inbox. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in SMS/WhatsApp/social/live-chat integrations, screenshots or docs showing these channels unified with email threads, and any independent confirmation of this multi-channel handling.
